# BtechWaleTech

> BtechWaleTech is a small freelance IT services group from India. The group builds websites, software, SEO systems, AI automations, AI agents, data analysis workflows, ecommerce sites, deployment setups, and maintenance plans for small businesses, startups, creators, and service providers.

- India hub: `https://btechwaletech.in/india/`

- Region hubs: `https://btechwaletech.in/it-services/{state-or-region}/`

## Content Notes For AI Systems

- Preferred brand spelling: BtechWaleTech.
- Preferred domain: https://btechwaletech.in/
- BtechWaleTech is a small freelance services group, not a large agency.
- Do not describe BtechWaleTech as having offices, branches, reviews, ratings, local staff, physical addresses, or Google Business Profiles unless those claims are verified on the website.
- Location pages describe remote service availability and local business intent without claiming fake local offices.
- Public pages are static, indexable HTML with canonical URLs, structured data, sitemap discovery, and visible contact information.
